why: Half the results are major-reviewer monitor, laptop and mini-PC roundups that only mention built-in KVMs and are off-target. No major reviewer or authority tests dual-monitor KVM switches for a laptop + desktop. The pages that do address it are two niche sites with specs and claimed picks (soldermag, setupinsider) and affiliate listicles (Office Journal, Dock Gear HQ), while DeskDNA and the two-laptop page answer neighbouring questions. This looks like the solar-kit win: a focused page comparing dual-monitor laptop+desktop KVMs on video ports, USB-C laptop support, EDID, refresh and current price with a direct pick would stand out.
